701:t_003:5.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We understand the principle of coexistence! That is precisely why we gained power and attained eternity like this!」

701:t_003:6.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「And we joined hands with Emperor $$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, who likewise became gods! We stand with the truth!」

701:t_003:9.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You've only just reached the gateway to $$シンカ$$! You have no right to speak!」

701:t_003:10.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That's exactly what you fail to understand, you fools!」

701:t_004:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「...The $$御使い$$s are the enemies we should defeat first... I thought we could cooperate, even temporarily, if we shared a goal...」

701:t_004:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「If that's how you want it, we won't hesitate to fight!」

701:t_004:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$ミケーネ$$! Army of darkness! We'll show you our new power!」

701:t_004:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「They're different! They aren't the same as before!」

701:t_004:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「It can. They grasped the truth and learned how to become one with their machines...」

701:t_004:7.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Its name is... $$真化融合$$! Taste its power to the fullest!」

701:t_004:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「Here we come, $$ミケーネ$$! Today we'll beat that conceit of yours out of you once and for all!」

701:t_004:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「And learn how strong our resolve and determination are!!」

701:t_005:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I confirm that $$ミケーネ$$ and the army of darkness have been annihilated.」

701:t_005:1.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The power of $$真化融合$$... It's astounding.」

701:t_005:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Indeed... It's our own power, yet it's frightening.」

701:t_005:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Someone was observing our battle from the shadows.」

701:t_006:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I thought I had concealed my presence.」

701:t_006:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「As we are now, we can sense you.」

701:t_006:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Our senses seem to have become sharper since we entered this universe.」

701:t_006:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Is that because you've advanced along the path to $$シンカ$$?」

701:t_006:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And I saw your new power for myself... $$真化融合$$...」

701:t_006:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'll say it again, $$ヴィルダーク$$. If you acknowledge our strength, I'd like your help defeating the $$御使い$$s.」

701:t_006:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I... cannot do that.」

701:t_006:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「This is my answer.」

701:t_007:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「What do you mean, this is your answer?!」

701:t_007:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$真化融合$$... That theory was proposed in our world, too.」

701:t_007:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But a theory is only a theory... We could not reach that state.」

701:t_007:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$リヴァイヴ・セル$$ was developed as an alternative.」

701:t_007:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「The substance that creates $$次元獣$$s...!」

701:t_007:7.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$次元獣$$s forcibly fuse humans and machines, producing greater power through dimensional power...」

701:t_007:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So that, too, is a simulated form of $$真化融合$$.」

701:t_007:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Your existence is the realization of our world's unattainable dream.」

701:t_007:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「At the same time, it denies everything we've done... everything about our army of $$次元獣$$s.」

701:t_007:11.en:
$$桂$$
「So you can't forgive us for existing.」

701:t_007:12.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It would be more accurate to say we are incompatible.」

701:t_007:13.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「If I acknowledged you, I would desecrate every life we've taken to create $$次元獣$$s.」

701:t_007:15.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I knew it. I knew our methods were wrong.」

701:t_007:16.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$次元獣ヴァルナー$$ has not reached its final form... That is probably proof of my hesitation.」

701:t_007:17.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, we had no choice... I kept believing... there was no other way. But it was all meaningless.」

701:t_007:18.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「All I can do is defeat you with this power to honor their lives...!」

701:t_007:19.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you're gonna fight us after all!」

701:t_007:20.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Thinking back, I have fought up to this day by forcing sacrifices on others...」

701:t_007:21.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ soldiers forced to fight under orders without even being told the circumstances...」

701:t_007:22.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$, who sought revenge for her father's life and $$ハイアデス$$' freedom being taken from her...」

701:t_007:23.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$, who sought to destroy the being that distorted his clan's mission...」

701:t_007:24.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$バルビエル$$, who swore obedience to them even after they annihilated all his people, warping his hatred...」

701:t_007:25.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$, who felt ashamed of drifting between anger and resignation, and regained his pride and will to live...」

701:t_007:26.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And the $$立ち上がる射手$$ $$リアクター$$ before me, who challenged the $$御使い$$s with indomitable fighting spirit...」

701:t_007:27.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I took their lives and gained the power of four $$スフィア$$s.」

701:t_007:28.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is why I must fight...! And I must win!」

701:t_007:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's pathetic when a man loses sight of what he should do out of self-satisfaction.」

701:t_007:32.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you know what you're doing is wrong, why won't you try to change yourself?!」

701:t_007:33.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't refuse to change when there's a better way!」

701:t_007:34.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your greatest mistake is the arrogance that keeps you from changing the way you live!」

701:t_007:35.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Say what you like. This is all I can do.」

701:t_007:37.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then I'll take you on! In a way that'll satisfy you!」

701:t_007:38.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We can't afford to lose, either!」

701:t_007:39.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Be careful! He's far stronger than when we fought him at $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

701:t_007:40.en:
$$シャア$$
「So he, too, can now draw out the power of four $$スフィア$$s!」

701:t_007:41.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But it's still not enough to defeat the fundamental calamity... the future of despair... the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_007:42.en:
$n
「Just as you can't accept our existence, we can't accept you after all the suffering you've brought to Earth!」

701:t_007:43.en:
$n
「Like hell we'll accept a future opened up by that kind of power!」

701:t_007:44.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then come, warriors of Earth! The victor will earn the right to challenge the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_007:45.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will surpass you and obtain god-killing power!!」

701:t_008:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So this is as far as I go...!」

701:t_008:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It goes without saying... You are the victors...」
